modules.name: Binary Search Trees & Balancing
modules.summary: Binary search trees maintain sorted keys for O(log n) average search, insertion, and deletion. Self-balancing trees like AVL and Red-Black trees apply tree rotations to avoid degenerate O(n) linked list behavior.

modules.name: Graph Traversal & Shortest Path
modules.summary: Graphs represent non-linear relationships with vertices and edges. Breadth-First Search (BFS) explores neighbor layers in O(V + E) time, while Dijkstra's algorithm uses priority queues for single-source shortest paths with non-negative weights.

modules.name: Dynamic Programming & Memoization
modules.summary: Dynamic programming breaks complex recursive problems into overlapping subproblems with optimal substructure. Memoization stores computed subproblem solutions to prevent redundant exponential O(2^n) recomputations.
